target.title: fix(zalouser): sanitize outbound tool traces
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Zalo Personal outbound delivery chunks and sends assistant text without running the shared `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText` delivery sanitizer used by the other #90684 channel fixes. Compact tool-trace failure lines could leak to Zalo Personal users.

Refs #90684.

## Why This Change Was Made

This exports the shared sanitizer through the local channel API barrel and adds it to `zalouserOutboundAdapter.sanitizeText`, matching the accepted sibling-channel pattern while keeping Zalo Personal's markdown chunking and payload delivery flow unchanged.

## User Impact

Zalo Personal recipients no longer see assistant internal tool-trace banners such as failed tool-call lines in outbound replies. Normal user-facing prose and markdown text are preserved.

## Evidence

- Current branch head: `4045447cec`, rebased onto upstream `main` `5537bc9c4d`.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 OPENCLAW_VITEST_FS_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=/tmp/oc-vitest-zalouser-sanitize-pr2 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/zalouser/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts extensions/zalouser/src/channel.sendpayload.test.ts --reporter=verbose`
  - 2 test files passed
  - 17 tests passed
- `~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/openclaw-pre-pr.sh --repo /root/projects/openclaw-sanitize-zalouser --pr-body /root/projects/sanitizer-sweep/pr-bodies/zalouser.md`
  - Passed full OpenClaw pre-PR gate, including `check:changed`.

Not tested: live Zalo Personal delivery.

AI-assisted change, manually reviewed and validated.
